text:
### Observed differences

- A new activity, A01, appears: in the earlier window it is absent from all 200 traces, while in the later window it runs exactly once in every one of the 200 traces (mean 1.0 occurrence per trace, no repeats) [OCC001].
- In the later window A01 sits at the end of cases: its median event position is the last position of the trace (mean about 0.94 of the trace), and only about 53 outgoing transitions from A01 appear across the 200 traces, so A01 ends most cases; in the earlier window it had no position or transitions at all [POS001, DIR001].
- A01 now co-occurs with every established activity and follows it. Before, each pair of A01 with A02–A08 showed the other activity occurring alone in 100 of 100 traces; after, A01 co-occurs with each of them in 100 of 100 traces, placed after A03, A07 and A08 in 100 of 100 traces, after A02 and A04 in about 99 of 100, after A05 in about 87 of 100 and after A06 in about 75 of 100 [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007].
- Flow into A01 changed accordingly: before, A08 typically ended the case (only about 75 outgoing transitions across 200 traces, about 51 in 100 of them to A05); after, A08 has outgoing transitions in all 200 traces and about 83 in 100 of them lead to A01. Where A01 is not final, it leads to A05 (about 45 in 100) or A06 (about 45 in 100) [DIR008, DIR001].
- Distances grew as if A01 were inserted: immediately consecutive A08→A05 pairs fell from about 66 to 33 in 100, and A08→A06 pairs moved from mostly two steps apart (about 52 in 100) to mostly three steps apart (about 46 in 100) [LAG035, LAG036].
- All established activities shifted slightly earlier in relative position (for example A08 from about 0.87 to 0.77 and A05 from 0.52 to 0.44 in mean relative position), the pattern expected when one event is appended at the end of each trace [POS005, POS006, POS008].
- Remaining differences are small: outgoing shares among A02–A08 moved by a few points (largest: A05→A06 from about 76 to 63 in 100, with about 6 in 100 of A05's transitions now going to A01), order shares among A02–A08 changed by at most about 7 points in 100, and a few lag shifts rest on few observations [DIR005, DIR002, DIR006, REL010, REL017, REL019, REL020, LAG007, LAG028, LAG034].

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that a new final activity, A01, was added to the process. In the earlier window A01 was not observed at all; in the later window it executes exactly once per case, after the established activities — A08, which previously often ended the case, now leads to A01 in about 83 in 100 of its outgoing transitions — usually as the last step, and in a minority of cases it is followed by A05 or A06. The participation change is observed directly with full support in both windows (0 vs 200 of 200 traces) [OCC001]; the placement is established by relational and directional evidence rather than inferred from position alone [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, DIR001, DIR008]; and the lengthened A08→A05/A06 distances plus the slightly earlier relative positions of all other activities point the same way [LAG035, LAG036, POS008]. The many relation, lag and position items largely re-describe this single behaviour and are not independent confirmations. An important competing explanation remains: zero participation in the earlier window means only that A01 was not observed there, so a recording change that began capturing a pre-existing final step cannot be ruled out; the evidence also carries no screening baseline of chance-expected items, so the judgement rests on the directness and consistency of the observations [OCC001].

Other differences: small redistributions among the pre-existing activities, such as A02→A07 rising from about 10 to 15 in 100 of A02's outgoing transitions, A05 before A08 rising from about 71 to 79 in 100, and the A03→A02 immediate-successor share rising from about 42 to 60 in 100; a few lag shifts (A07→A02, A08→A04) rest on very few observations (31 vs 19 and 5 vs 8) and may be sampling variation [DIR002, REL020, REL017, LAG007, LAG028, LAG034].
